# Course Delivery Checklist v1

Use this checklist when creating or migrating a course to `Course Delivery Standard v1`.

## Repository entry point

- [ ] Root README presents the course, audience and learning arc.
- [ ] Release/freeze status is visible.
- [ ] Teacher and student entry points are distinct.
- [ ] Clickable module index exists.
- [ ] Every indexed module links to its canonical lesson.
- [ ] Every applicable module links to slides.
- [ ] Every applicable module links to lab/activity.
- [ ] Longitudinal project milestones are visible when present.

## Slides

- [ ] Stable source format exists.
- [ ] Every module has a deck or stable anchor.
- [ ] Slides contain recall, objectives, examples, checkpoints, lab handoff and recap.
- [ ] Slides are not merely copied lesson text.
- [ ] PDF/HTML/PPTX generation path is documented when available.

## Teacher guide

- [ ] Suggested timing.
- [ ] Demo plan.
- [ ] Common misconceptions.
- [ ] Recovery/enrichment options.
- [ ] Rubrics/solutions location.
- [ ] Classroom preparation notes.
- [ ] TheBitLab/platform dependencies.

## Student guide

- [ ] Install/bootstrap path.
- [ ] Run/test/debug workflow.
- [ ] Environment/venv/dependency procedure.
- [ ] TheBitLab workflow.
- [ ] Submission/evidence procedure.
- [ ] Troubleshooting/reset procedure.
- [ ] Physical-lab safety procedure where applicable.

## Labs

- [ ] Objective and prerequisites are explicit.
- [ ] Starter/input is available.
- [ ] Execution instructions are reproducible.
- [ ] Expected evidence/output is explicit.
- [ ] Automated vs manual grading status is explicit.
- [ ] Reset/retry path exists.
- [ ] Project/milestone mapping exists when applicable.

## In-year maintenance

- [ ] Delivery revision policy documented.
- [ ] Patch-safe vs curriculum-significant changes distinguished.
- [ ] In-year change log exists.
- [ ] Canonical source is updated before generated artifacts.
- [ ] Superseded classroom artifacts can be identified.

## Quality

- [ ] Internal links checked.
- [ ] Indexed lessons exist.
- [ ] Slide links/anchors checked.
- [ ] Required labs exist.
- [ ] Teacher/student separation checked.
- [ ] Generated artifacts build when configured.
- [ ] Existing Content Pack/Course Design/Activity gates stay green.
- [ ] Executable setup/runtime instructions are regression-tested when feasible.

## Adoption level

- [ ] Level 0 — Legacy indexed
- [ ] Level 1 — Classroom navigable
- [ ] Level 2 — Teacher ready
- [ ] Level 3 — Reproducible delivery
- [ ] Level 4 — Platform integrated
